scenicChapters.title: Armenia Debed Canyon Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 9 km this is Armenia Debed Canyon Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

story: A one-way ride of 274 km, Yerevan to Alaverdi - roughly 3 h 47 in the saddle. It goes by way of Dilijan, Vanadzor and Haghpat. The highest point is about 2,200 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

waypoints.advice: 131 km in you reach Selim Pass. The road climbs 2410 m over the 66 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 16 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Orbelian Caravanserai, 65 km on and mostly downhill.

scenicChapters.title: Armenia Selim Pass and Lake Sevan Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Armenia Selim Pass and Lake Sevan Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2410 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

story: Out of Yerevan and back again: 261 km, roughly 4 h 18 in the saddle. It goes by way of Noravank, Selim Pass and Orbelian Caravanserai. The highest point is about 2,400 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
